decision: done = pnpm check (oxlint, biome, tsrs, vitest) green and each tool fails on a seeded error; plus an e2e script where an ACP client goes through nc and acp-mux to a local Worker DO, the agent writes a file, reports a diff, calls the typecheck service, and ends the turn
why: a falsifiable target before building

decision: one pnpm workspace in this repo, separate from T3; no fork
why: T3 server is 231k lines with daily protocol churn; ACP local command needs no T3 change

decision: no deploys in this run; local dev only (wrangler or alchemy dev, local typecheck service)
why: deploys are an always-pause action

decision: research first in three read-only delegates: T3 conventions and tooling, ACP contract T3 expects, Effect plus Alchemy plus Cloudflare APIs
why: architecture depends on all three and they are independent

decision: match T3: Effect 4 one-service-per-file, Schema.TaggedError, Effect.fn spans, @effect/vitest, strict tsconfig, pnpm catalog, knip; Biome formats only, oxlint lints
why: operator asked to match T3 style; Biome lint off avoids two linters on the same rules

decision: typecheck with tsrs (oxc-project, Cloudflare-backed), not T3's tsc-rs
why: operator named tsrs; native tsrs 0.20.1 already caught both seeded errors in /tmp/tsrs-native

decision: pin ACP v1; hand-written line dispatcher over vendored effect-acp v1 schemas; advertise mcpCapabilities.acp only; no load/resume/fork/list/auth
why: v1 ends a turn with stopReason directly; v2 session capabilities make T3 assume load/list/resume/close; effect-acp agent helper is v2 and stdio-only

decision: session/new must be cheap and session/cancel must answer the open prompt with cancelled
why: T3 probes with initialize plus a throwaway session/new under 60s; T3 waits forever on cancel otherwise

decision: wrote data shapes and three units: scaffold+protocol, three apps in parallel worktrees, end-to-end script
why: shapes are settled by the research, so no arena round; scaffold first because every app depends on it

decision: one DO per ACP connection, not per session; mux stays a dumb pipe that never parses ACP
why: no session/load in v1 prototype, so a connection lives as long as the thread's agent process; keeps protocol logic in one place

decision: pin effect 4.0.6 and Alchemy 2.0.0-beta.84
why: pnpm minimumReleaseAge rejects effect 4.0.7, published today

decision: restart Unit 1 from a clean tree; swap Biome for oxfmt, run through Vite+ (vp) if it installs cleanly and accepts tsrs, else plain pnpm scripts
why: first delegate was cancelled by accident; oxfmt keeps lint, format and typecheck on one Oxc toolchain and matches T3's setup

decision: use Vite+ 1.4.0 (vp lint/fmt/test/run) as the toolchain driver
why: operator default; installs under pnpm 12.15 policy with ignore-scripts; vp run -r typecheck drives tsrs per package
evidence: probe /tmp/vp-probe: pnpm install 1.9s; vp run -r typecheck -> TS2322 exit 2

decision: Vitest 5.0.5, not 4
why: '@effect/vitest@4.0.6 peers vitest >=5 <6; Vite+ 1.4.0 bundles vitest 5.0.5; vitest-plugin 1.4.9 peers ^4.1||^5

decision: no @effect/vitest patch; catalog vite to vite-plus-core and override vitest to one version
why: T3 patches @effect/vitest to import vite-plus/test; with the override the unpatched package resolves the same vitest and it.effect passes and fails correctly
0.20.1 published 2026-10-28, inside minimumReleaseAge

decision: Cloudflare tests run as a per-package vp test with cloudflareTest() from @cloudflare/vitest-plugin 1.4.9
why: Worker+DO test with it.effect passed in workerd under vp test and failed on a planted assertion; root vp run -r test runs Node and Worker packages together; no conflict with Vite+
evidence: probe packages/w: Tests 2 passed; planted '2'->'3' AssertionError

decision: Worker tsconfig = base + lib ES2023 + types [@cloudflare/workers-types 5.20261027.1, @cloudflare/vitest-plugin/types]; env via declare global Cloudflare.Env; tests import env/exports from cloudflare:workers
why: tsrs passes it and fails on a planted error; alchemy.run.ts with alchemy/@alchemy.run/cloudflare 2.0.0-beta.84 also type-checks under tsrs; cloudflare:test env/SELF are deprecated in 1.4.9
evidence: probe: tsrs exit 0; planted TS2304 and TS2322 exit 2

decision: turn on type-aware oxlint (typeAware: true via bundled oxlint-tsgolint 7.0.2004)
why: it runs under vp lint and catches real bugs such as floating promises; T3 keeps it off
evidence: probe: vp lint reported typescript(no-floating-promises) exit 1

decision: use T3's real initialize line as the protocol fixture
why: captured by running T3 effect-acp client.ts (125b619) against in-memory stdio with adapter.ts client caps, so the test decodes what T3 sends, not a reconstruction
evidence: first outbound line, id 1073741824, includes traceId/spanId

decision: type-aware oxlint stays on
why: pnpm check runs it green; it found 3 unsafe casts in the ported T3 rules, fixed with type guards rather than turning no-unsafe-type-assertion off as T3 does
evidence: vp lint typescript(no-unsafe-type-assertion) at utils.ts:15, no-inline-schema-compile.ts:47, no-polling-loop-in-tests.ts:73

decision: port 12 T3 lint rules into packages/oxlint-plugin (@dorbs/oxlint-plugin) with their 11 test files; skip no-global-process-runtime
why: oxlint JS plugins load under vp lint; no-global-process-runtime tells callers to use T3's HostProcess service, which this repo lacks; React/mobile/UI rules out of scope per conventions doc

decision: skip the Effect language-service block in tsconfig.base.json
why: tsrs is a TS7 port and its CLI runs no tsserver plugins, so the block would be dead config

decision: no Cloudflare/alchemy entries in the catalog yet; Unit 2 adds them at the logged versions
why: knip fails on unused catalog entries

decision: format docs/research with oxfmt; exclude decisions.tsv from fmt
why: fmt --check covers markdown; changes are whitespace and table layout only
evidence: git diff --stat docs/research: 3 files, layout only

decision: verify-gates.sh runs the same pnpm scripts pnpm check composes; plants typecheck and test errors once per package that has the script
why: proves each package is really checked, and a new package is covered without editing the script
evidence: bash scripts/verify-gates.sh: 5 gates ok, check green in 14s; SIGTERM mid-run exits 130 with no __gate files left

decision: vendor the ACP v1 subset with a committed script (scripts/vendor-acp-v1.ts) that keeps the dependency closure of the ten plan roots
why: rerunnable, so a reviewer can diff it against upstream; strips string literals before scanning so prose in descriptions does not pull in extra declarations

decision: lint override: typescript/no-redundant-type-constituents off for the vendored acp.ts only; no-underscore-dangle off globally
why: upstream open enums are '"known" | string' on purpose; Effect unions discriminate on _tag; T3 turns both rules off
evidence: vp lint errors at acp.ts:772-837 and *.test.ts _tag

decision: JSON-RPC and CheckResponse member schemas stay module-private; only their types and the unions are exported
why: knip includeEntryExports flags exports with no consumer; Unit 2 exports a member when an app needs it

decision: encodeFrame returns the NDJSON line with its trailing newline; decodeFrame accepts it with or without
why: the line is the wire unit, so the mux and the DO write it unchanged

decision: protocol tests survive mutation
why: each exported function has a test that fails when it returns undefined
evidence: decodeFrame->succeed(undefined): 4 failed; encodeFrame->undefined: 2 failed; CheckRequest->Any: 2 failed

decision: RelativePath checks each slash-separated segment instead of one regex, and rejects backslashes and control characters
why: security review: the regex lookahead used . which stops at a newline, so a newline followed by /../b was accepted; consumers still resolve under the root
evidence: repro: Schema.is(RelativePath)(a newline /../b) was true, now false; new test cases failed before the fix
